items.title: Citi and Coinbase to launch bank-grade stablecoin payments
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Citi (C) expanding its relationship by allowing Coinbase (COIN) business users to obtain bank-like account details to accept, hold, and send standard fiat currency. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Apple Launches Mobile Payment Services in India
items.summary: Users in India can now use Apple Pay on iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches via a partnership with Axis Bank, one of the largest private-sector lenders in the country.

items.title: Apple Pay finally launches in India after years on the sidelines
items.summary: Some of India's largest banks are holding off on supporting Apple Pay initially.

items.title: Going Rogue and Getting a Wallet: The $53 Billion AI Commerce Crisis No One Is Ready For
items.summary: AI agents are already swiping cards, placing orders, and flooding complaint systems, and Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Shopify are all racing to build guardrails for a trust problem that has no agreed-upon solution yet.

items.title: Mastercard Expands B2B Payments With AI-Powered Analytics
items.summary: MA's AI-powered B2B Analytics targets suppliers likely to accept cards, helping banks expand commercial-card opportunities and payment volumes.

items.title: 3 Financials Stocks to Research Further
items.summary: Financial providers use their expertise in capital allocation and risk assessment to help facilitate economic growth while offering consumers and businesses essential financial services. But worries about economic uncertainty and potential market volatility have kept sentiment in check, and over the past six months, the industry’s 12% return has trailed the S&P 500 by 10.1 percentage points.

items.title: Is MasterCard (MA) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), MasterCard (MA) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: Here's How Visa's AptPay Deal Expands Its iGaming Payments Opportunity
items.summary: Visa expands its iGaming payments opportunity as AptPay integration brings faster payouts and Visa Direct Alias to the growing US online gaming market.
